description: Profile a slow data processing script by adding timing instrumentation and documenting the bottleneck. The workspace contains 'data_processor.py' which processes CSV data through multiple stages. Add timing measurements using Python's time module (time.perf_counter()) around each major stage: read_data(), validate_data(), transform_data(), and write_output(). Execute the script to observe timing, identify which stage is slowest, and create a file 'performance_analysis.md' documenting: (1) the problem, (2) your measurement method, (3) timing results for each stage, (4) which stage is the bottleneck (should be validation), and (5) the evidence (actual timing numbers in seconds). The script processes 'input_data.csv' and outputs 'processed_data.csv'.
